== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34604) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Jellison DS AOBS.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 28 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>11e397c3b2cc6eea0d701466de1241c96f33e8123e071618130c08f566018467</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

GEMP foil-display modifiers retained in the original import: <nowiki>10_29*, 10_45*, 12_143*, 200_110*, 200_79*, 201_38*, 203_31*, 203_32*, 203_34*, 206_12*, 209_43*, 7_278*, 9_139*</nowiki>. These visual settings did not create additional historical foil publications in the article.
